@common.sizeUnit.byte.sameAsSourceJustification: byte / bytes is the Spanish unit noun too (RAE: el byte, los bytes; macOS es Finder writes bytes); only the CLDR many branch is added.

@common.sizeUnit.kibibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC 80000-13 binary symbol, written the same in Spanish (es pile: Thunar es 512 KiB / 10 MiB, Dolphin es MiB, Microsoft terminology es MiB).

@common.sizeUnit.mebibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC 80000-13 binary symbol, written the same in Spanish (es pile: Thunar es 512 KiB / 10 MiB, Dolphin es MiB, Microsoft terminology es MiB).

@common.sizeUnit.gibibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC 80000-13 binary symbol, written the same in Spanish (es pile: Thunar es 512 KiB / 10 MiB, Dolphin es MiB, Microsoft terminology es MiB).

@common.sizeUnit.tebibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC 80000-13 binary symbol, written the same in Spanish (es pile: Thunar es 512 KiB / 10 MiB, Dolphin es MiB, Microsoft terminology es MiB).

@common.sizeUnit.pebibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC 80000-13 binary symbol, written the same in Spanish (es pile: Thunar es 512 KiB / 10 MiB, Dolphin es MiB, Microsoft terminology es MiB).

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI symbol with the lowercase k prefix, written the same in Spanish (es pile: Nautilus es 4 kB / 4 MB); distinct from the binary KiB.

@common.sizeUnit.megabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol; macOS es writes MB too (Finder size strings in the es pile).

@common.sizeUnit.gigabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol; macOS es writes GB too (Finder size strings in the es pile).

@common.sizeUnit.terabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI unit symbol, identical in Spanish (same family as KB, MB, GB, which macOS es writes unchanged).

@common.sizeUnit.petabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI unit symbol, identical in Spanish (same family as KB, MB, GB, which macOS es writes unchanged).
